snippet.title: Time Gal (PS1) Playthrough - NintendoComplete
snippet.description:
A playthrough of Taito's 1996 interactive movie Laserdisc arcade title port for the Sony PlayStation, Time Gal. 

This game is sweet - it's classic 80s hero girl anime, and it looks awesome. Just like the Ninja Hayate port that came packaged with Time Gal, just about everything (besides random grunts and one-word yells) is in English. More than any of the other laserdisc games that were released on both the Sega CD and the PS1, this one benefits the most from the upgraded hardware. The original game, while really cool, ended up being super choppy with loads of frames of animation missing, making it look like a animated gif file. This one, on the other hand, is right about on par with the original Laserdisc. 
____
No cheats were used during the recording of this video.
